D.label: frustum + join cuboid on top
D.src:
const a = sketch('top'); a.rect(40, 40); const b = sketch('top'); b.rect(20, 20); const f = loft(a, b, 30);
const c = cuboid(10, 10, 10); move(c, [0, 0, 40]); join(f, c);
